name: Light sensor module (LDR)
description: A photoresistor on a small board with a comparator (LM393). Power it from 5V and GND. AO is an analog voltage that goes up in the dark (the LDR and a 10kΩ resistor make a divider): read it with analogRead(). DO is digital: LOW when it is bright, HIGH when it is dark; the switching point is the Threshold voltage on AO (the blue trimmer on a real module). The DO LED lights when light is detected. Select it and drag the Light slider while the simulation runs.
